summary: Frontend-only validation of the new MikiLab one-page 3-section structure (390x844 + 1920x800). PIN 1985 -> operatore-michele -> default section-control verified. All 3 nav tabs (nav-ricette/nav-control/nav-guida) switch sections without crashes (2 full cycles, ErrorBoundary never triggered, no page errors, no broken images). Guida SOS renders guida-sos with faq-0..4 all expanding. Control section: mode-lab-btn -> lab-control-view with all 5 cards present; lab-nav-magazzino -> magazzino-manager, lab-nav-iot -> peripheral-setup, lab-nav-ricette -> conferma-impastata, lab-nav-planner OK. Ordini Extra AI verified end-to-end: typed '+30 baguette per Bar Centrale entro le 11:00', clicked ordini-extra-btn, ordini-extra-plan returned a full regenerated plan (~20s). account-btn opens auth-screen and auth-close closes it. One real defect found: the FIRST tap on the PIN keypad is silently swallowed right after load, so the PIN never reaches 4 digits (reproduced 2/2 without a settle wait; works after ~4s settle).

ui_bugs.issue: First keypad tap after page load is lost (pin-dots stays at 0 filled). Entering 1-9-8-5 immediately after the keypad appears results in only 3 dots filled and no auto-submit, leaving the user stuck on the lock screen until they notice and add a digit. Reproduced twice at 390x844 (150ms and 500ms between taps); works only after waiting ~4s before the first tap.
AI plan is rendered as raw markdown ('# ', '**bold**', '---' visible as text) inside ordini-extra-plan instead of formatted output.

issues: Default mode is 'Produzione · Floor' (activeMode initial state 'floor'), so the Capo plancia/5 cards require an extra tap on mode-lab-btn - confirm this is intended since the request describes Capo cards as the primary landing view.
Section scroll position is preserved when switching nav tabs, so the SectionHead of the newly opened section can be off-screen (user lands mid-content). Consider scrolling to top on section change.

action_items: Fix PinLock losing the first keypad press on cold load (see RCA) - highest priority, it blocks app entry.
Optional: render the Ordini Extra AI plan as markdown instead of raw text.
Optional: scroll window to top when the section changes; confirm intended default mode (floor vs lab) in Section 2.
critical_code_review_comments: PinLock.press uses the `pin` value captured in the render closure (`const np = pin + d`) instead of a functional setState; combined with a re-render/remount from the async language/profile init this loses the first digit. Use setPin(p => ...) and derive the submit from the updated value.
PIN is stored in plaintext in localStorage (mikilab_pin=1985) - acceptable for a kiosk PIN but should be documented; anyone with devtools can read it.
App.js keeps section/mode/view in three separate states with no scroll reset or URL sync; deep-linking/back-button do not work for the one-page nav.

success_rate.frontend: 92% (all flows pass; 1 HIGH PIN entry bug)

seed_data_creation: None - no warehouse/magazzino items were created; only one Ordini Extra AI call (no persistence).
test_credentials: App PIN 1985; operator michele (no account login used)
context_for_next_testing_agent: Automation must wait ~3-4s after [data-testid="pin-lock"] appears before pressing pin-key digits, otherwise the first digit is dropped (real bug, not test flake). Full flow verified: PIN -> operatore-michele -> section-control -> mode-lab-btn -> lab-nav-* cards -> ordini-extra (AI ~20s). Guida faq-0..4 and nav switching are stable.
rca_of_the_issue: PinLock's press() computes the new pin from the stale closure value and the component re-renders/remounts during initial app bootstrap (language/profile providers resolving), so the state update from the first tap is discarded. Result: 4 taps produce a 3-digit pin, the length===4 auto-submit never fires. Fix with functional setState (and/or delay rendering PinLock until lang init resolves).
